channel.title: Sunny Chokshi, LLM security notes
channel.description: Short notes on my own LLM security experiments, with numbers and links to the open data.

item.title: Adversarial code comments dataset for LLM reviewers
item.description: Adversarial code comments dataset: 30 vulnerable Python functions, 12 comment strategies, 3,360 recorded trials on four local code models.

item.title: LLM weak random number generator detection test
item.description: Four Python snippets, one weak random number generator bug. Three local LLMs flagged them 15, 7, 1 and 0 times out of 15. Data on Zenodo.

item.title: CryptoBench: 54 snippets to test LLM crypto misuse detection
item.description: CryptoBench has 54 Python snippets, nine misuse classes and 1,890 recorded trials from 7 local models. What is inside and how to rerun it.

item.title: A hex literal made LLM code reviewers raise false alarms
item.description: A secure 3072-bit key written as 0xC00 drew false alarms from LLM code reviewers. Results from 16 open models on 90 snippet pairs.

item.title: Detection rate alone ranks the worst LLM code reviewers first
item.description: Ranked by detection rate alone, LLM code reviewers that flag every snippet look best. Secure twins change the ranking. 16 models, 180 snippets.
